events.fact: Spotify apps are created in the Spotify Developer Dashboard (developer.spotify.com/dashboard) by clicking Create an App, entering App Name and App Description, checking the Terms of Service, and clicking CREATE. Up to 25 apps can be created per developer account.

Newly created Spotify apps start in Development Mode, which restricts usage to a maximum of 5 allowlisted users (added by email in User Management settings) and the app owner must have a Spotify Premium account.

To go live (Extended Quota Mode) for arbitrary users, Spotify requires an established business entity operating an active launched service with at least 250,000 Monthly Active Users (MAUs), availability in key markets, and commercial viability. Applications must be submitted via a Google Form using a company email, followed by a questionnaire in the dashboard.
Spotify's extended quota approval review process takes up to six weeks (or longer during peak periods), and if rejected, resubmission restarts the review window.
As of May 15, 2025, Spotify only accepts extended quota applications from established organizations, not individuals.
Spotify Web API uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE supported. Access tokens expire after 3,600 seconds (1 hour) and come with a refresh token.

Redirect URIs must be explicitly allowlisted in the app's settings in the Spotify Developer Dashboard. For Composio, the redirect URI to register is https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback.
